description: This file defines the MoveBlockForm class for Drupal's Layout Builder module, providing a form to move blocks between regions and sections within a layout, including AJAX handling and form building logic.

classes.name: Drupal ormat_builder orm\MoveBlockForm
classes.description: A form class for moving blocks within Drupal's Layout Builder, handling form display, submission, and AJAX interactions.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the move block form with region selection and block ordering.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to move the block to a new section and region.

methods.name: getComponentsWrapper
methods.description: AJAX callback to return the components table wrapper.

methods.name: successfulAjaxSubmit
methods.description: Handles successful AJAX form submission, rebuilding and closing the form.

methods.name: getSelectedRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the selected region from form state.

methods.name: getSelectedDelta
methods.description: Retrieves the selected section delta from form state.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Provides a dynamic title for the move block form based on block label.
